CONTRADICTION RECORDED, NOT RESOLVED: [0084] has a mixture containing B converting to A while [0086] has pure B converting to C, in the same medium at the same temperature; and [0063] justifies excluding B on formulation stability, not on conversion, so B converting to a claimed form is not in itself the disqualification.

section_label: Suitability as Herbicides and Plant Protection Agents
notes: VOCABULARY GAP, decided. This is agrochemical formulation, not pharmaceutical, and the closed enum has no agrochemical value; pharmaceutical_compositions is used as the nearest available, exactly as EP2045236A1 does for its crop-protection formulation sections, and the mismatch is recorded here rather than escaping to other.
